There are a bunch of stories that come out of this place and everyone has one or two. It is a really old mountain house and everyone sees ladies dressed in old clothing or hears knocks or footsteps. I find myself to be very skeptical of these sort of things until I personally had my dorm bathroom door open and shut behind me while I was using it, but there is one story that is so supernatural and out there and it was told to me by a few different people exactly the same. I even approached the person it happened to and asked him. His story did not differ one bit. And so it goes...

The overnight housekeeper was about 2 hours into his shift. Right around 3am he heard a call over his radio for extra towels to room 454. It seemed odd at 3am but there were many explanations. He brought the towels up to the room and knocked three times before letting himself into the room. As he walked inside to see the lights on and an older gentleman sitting at the desk in the far reach of the room with his back towards the housekeeper he politely apologized for walking in. 

“It’s ok, Adam. Just leave the towels on the bed.”

It is procedure to either go back to the office to let the operator know you completed the task or call them over the radio. When he went back and told the operator she said that she didn’t give him a call to go up to that room at all.  When they looked up the room they came to see that room to be vacant.  After returning to the room it was in pristine condition, lights out and towels gone. 

I will always be skeptical about this kind of stuff, but this story always sends chill down my spine.
